architecture.mechanism: sulfites as dechlorinating agents to prevent biofilm formation by eliminating residual oxidants that promote microbial growth
architecture.intervention: inject sodium bisulfite or sodium metabisulfite into the feedwater upstream of the RO membranes to neutralize residual oxidants (e.g., ozone, peroxides) without chlorine, reducing biofilm precursor conditions
architecture.expected_effect: extended CIP interval to ≥3 months and normalized flux droop <5% by suppressing microbial adhesion and oxidative stress on polyamide membranes
architecture.falsification_test: measure residual oxidant levels (e.g., ORP) and biofilm biomass (ATP swabs) pre- and post-sulfite injection; compare CIP frequency and flux decline to historical data
